name: Perigee Abyss
core_rationale: Lowest inverted gravity trench of Continent 03 where Vesper's sunken basalt anchors hang directly above the northern ocean maelstrom.
local_conflict: Abyssal gravity-wraiths and deep-tide leviathans prowl the inverted basalt anchor-chains at the bottom of the Shattered Halo.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Tether-divers say that if you drop a brass coin from Perigee Abyss, it falls upward for three minutes before splashing into Nebula Undertide.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A ring of inverted basalt stalactites hanging just above the roaring spray of the northern ocean whirlpool.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What ancient sea-gate lies submerged directly beneath the lowest basalt anchor of Perigee Abyss?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater at the lowest perigee rim of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Inverted basalt stalactites suspended above the roaring spray of the northern ocean maelstrom.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 12.5m basalt anchor-chain boardwalks, 0.60m winch-lock benches, and 0.14m basalt risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting playable leaf map authoring for Stalactite Plunge and Perigee Diving-Station.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Includes complete mystery_hook and reserves hunting-area-stalactite-plunge as a Mystery frontier.
